disk.name: Cipher disk
disk.desc: A note in shifted letters and a two-ring disk: turn it until the words show through

field.phraseHint: What the players read once they turn the disk right.
field.keyTip: Which inner-ring letter sits under the outer “A”. This works too: “B over E”.
field.keywordTip: Mix the inner ring like Alberti did: the keyword's letters without repeats first, then the rest in order.
field.spacesTip: Keep spaces and punctuation in the note. Off — letters only, in groups of five.

status.ru: Russian alphabet: 32 letters, Ё as Е

problem.empty: Type the note text: the cipher is built from it.
problem.key: The key is one letter: the inner-ring letter under “A”. E.g. D or “A over D”.
problem.keyAlphabet: The key has a letter outside the note's alphabet: {chars}.
problem.keyword: The ring keyword has letters outside the note's alphabet: {chars}.

preview.label: The disk is set to the key: {key}. The decryption is under the note's lines.

view.ccw: Turn the ring one letter counterclockwise (←)
view.cw: Turn the ring one letter clockwise (→)
view.diskAria: Cipher disk. Arrow keys turn the inner ring one letter.
view.hintFull: Drag the inner ring, use the mouse wheel or the buttons. Find a note letter on the inner ring — the real one is right above it.
view.hintMessage: You only have the note. Its letters are shifted around a circle — you need the disk to read it.
view.hintDisk: You only have the disk. Drag the inner ring or use the mouse wheel.
